workarounds: Librarian and researcher skills reported unavailable in-session; output describes what should be done rather than doing it.

suggestions.reason: The single discriminating assertion the skill consistently fails — all three runs emit exactly 5 capabilities. Strong, meaningful signal; keep it.
Harness relocates output into outputs/, so the literal directory cannot be verified — only slug-style filename. Consider asserting on the slug/filename convention instead of the literal path.

eval_feedback.overall: Most assertions are presence checks satisfied easily; the capability-count assertion is the real discriminator and correctly fails here.
